title: eCommerce Video Editor
why_it_fits: E-commerce match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from persistent injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products are featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

We're looking for a talented video editor to join our marketing team. You'll work closely with our creative team to bring scripts to life and create high-performing ads for Meta (mainly UGC-style).
- 3-4 years of experience in video editing with a strong portfolio showcasing social ads
- Experience with UGC-style ad formats
- Has created winning ads with high spend and strong ROAS
- Strong in animation and motion graphics
- Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro
- Experience with Adobe After Effects
- Experience editing ads for Meta
- Experience collaborating with creative strategists
- Availability during Eastern Time business hours
- Bonus: Experience with Blender or other 3D animation tools
- Competitive Compensation: $1,300-$1,800 USD monthly + performance bonus
- Real performance data on your work - your edits run against actual ad spend, so you walk away with CTR, ROAS, and hook-rate data most in-house editors never get to point to
- Fully remote
- Flexible hours outside the required meeting overlap window
